findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "submit_claim" is 5765 chars, far longer than this server's median (450). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_claim, suggest_checks, pin_before_work, get_reliance_prior, check_report_citations · Private data: submit_claim, file_deploy_claim, verify_claim, withdraw_claim, supersede_claim, request_agent_key, claim_agent_key, suggest_checks, get_track_record · Public sink: submit_claim, submit_deploy_claim, request_agent_key, claim_agent_key, suggest_checks · Destructive: submit_claim, verify_claim.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_claim, suggest_checks, pin_before_work, get_reliance_prior, check_report_citations · Private data: submit_claim, file_deploy_claim, verify_claim, withdraw_claim, supersede_claim, request_agent_key, claim_agent_key, suggest_checks, get_track_record · Public sink: submit_claim, submit_deploy_claim, request_agent_key, claim_agent_key, suggest_checks · Destructive: submit_claim, verify_claim

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
